main_body: Large leafy tree canopy made of several lobed leaf clumps, with a brown trunk and exposed roots at the bottom
top_band: Canopy clumps with light-green (lime) highlighted tops, rows ~1-12 at the crown, stepping down to mid and dark greens; trunk/roots below from row ~60
evidence: Organic tree. Each leaf clump has a lit light-green top and a darker underside, so the canopy reads as volumes seen from above. The dark foliage beneath the clumps shades the trunk and branches, and the trunk has roots flaring out at the base. No receding isometric side faces. The 3/4 reading comes from clump shading, not from a rigid top/front slab, which suits an organic kind.

style.evidence: The canopy has about five green steps, from lime highlight through mid greens to deep dark green. Clumps are shaded individually with scalloped edges. Outlines are dark green beside leaves and dark brown beside the trunk, not black. The trunk and roots carry several brown steps with highlight streaks. The candidate is about as rich as the larger reference tree, with no large flat fills, and has varied tiles throughout.
